execution.raw_text:
{
  "sql": "SELECT
  m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(a.pubmed_id, a.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities act
INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON act.tid = td.tid
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary m ON act.molregno = m.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND td.pref_name = 'Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
ORDER BY
  molecule_chembl_id,
  canonical_smiles,
  compound_key,
  pubmed_id_or_doi,
  assay_description,
  standard_type,
  standard_relation,
  standard_value,
  standard_units,
  activity_comment,
  target_chembl_id,
  target_name,
  target_organism;"
}
